ling-shu-agent-designer v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "灵枢 · Agent 设计师" skill, focusing on structured Agent design without code implementation.
- Introduces a 4-step workflow: requirements communication → scenario outline (7 mandatory items) → foundation Agent creation → iterative skill upgrades.
- Provides detailed outline and delivery templates for Agent design in industry scenarios.
- Emphasizes configuration + skill package approach, not code-heavy development.
- Incorporates methodology inspired by Wu Minghui, Andrew Ng, and Fu Sheng for organization, process, and practical delivery.
- Includes scenarios for triggering the skill and principles to ensure rapid, scenario-driven Agent deployments.
